result.markdown:
# Transport Fiber Link Failure in Sahel

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SAH-02-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarm evidence of LINK_LOS on the transport link matching the exact site down onset, with maintenance and changes checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 16:15 to 2026-09-11 20:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 16:23
- **Affected:** S-SAH-005, S-SAH-010, S-SAH-011

## Summary

Fiber link loss on LNK-SAH-02-B disrupted connectivity to three connected sites, causing simultaneous site down alarms and traffic drops.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped to zero on three sites in Sahel from 2026-09-11 16:15 until recovery around 20:30.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-11 15:22: Routing policy update config push executed on AGG-SAH-02. [CHG-2026-0031]
- 2026-09-11 16:15: Alert ALR-0012 detected traffic, availability, and active users drop on three sites. [T1, ALR-0012]
- 2026-09-11 16:23: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on transport link LNK-SAH-02-B. [ALM-000210]
- 2026-09-11 16:24: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SAH-005, S-SAH-010, and S-SAH-011. [ALM-000211, ALM-000212, ALM-000213]
- 2026-09-11 20:22: LINK_LOS alarm cleared on LNK-SAH-02-B. [ALM-000210]
- 2026-09-11 20:30: Alert ALR-0012 ended following site recoveries. [T1, ALR-0012]

## Evidence

- Sites S-SAH-005, S-SAH-010, and S-SAH-011 depend on fiber link LNK-SAH-02-B and aggregator AGG-SAH-02. [T5, T6, T7]
- Critical LINK_LOS occurred on LNK-SAH-02-B at 16:23. [ALM-000210]
- Sites S-SAH-005, S-SAH-010, and S-SAH-011 raised SITE_DOWN alarms at 16:24. [ALM-000211, ALM-000212, ALM-000213]
- No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected sites and parents. [T4]
- A config push occurred on AGG-SAH-02 at 15:22. [CHG-2026-0031]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SAH-02-B: confirmed. Direct LINK_LOS alarm on LNK-SAH-02-B at 16:23 matches the immediate cascading SITE_DOWN alarms on all child sites. [ALM-000210, ALM-000211, ALM-000212, ALM-000213]
2. **bad_change** at AGG-SAH-02: rejected. Config push occurred nearly an hour prior to impact onset and transport fiber loss directly explains the simultaneous failure. [CHG-2026-0031, ALM-000210]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0031: Occurred at 15:22, which is too early to align with the 16:15 traffic drop and 16:23 link loss.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect fiber link LNK-SAH-02-B for physical damage or degradation.
- Review stability of routing policy changes applied on aggregator nodes.

## Sources

- `CHG-2026-0031`: config_push on AGG-SAH-02 at 2026-09-11 15:22: Routing policy update on AGG-SAH-02
- `T1`: get_anomalies(start=2026-09-11 10:00, end=2026-09-12 08:28, region_id=SAH) -> 1 alert(s): ALR-0012 2026-09-11 16:15-20:30. Traffic, active users and availability drop on 3 sites in SAH (S-SAH-005, S-SAH-010, S-SAH-011) for 4 h

- `ALM-000210`: critical LINK_LOS on LNK-SAH-02-B, raised 2026-09-11 16:23, cleared 2026-09-11 20:22
- `ALM-000211`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SAH-010, raised 2026-09-11 16:24, cleared 2026-09-11 20:24
- `ALM-000212`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SAH-005, raised 2026-09-11 16:24, cleared 2026-09-11 20:26
- `ALM-000213`: critical SITE_DOWN on S-SAH-011, raised 2026-09-11 16:24, cleared 2026-09-11 20:25

confounders.why: Harmless config_push on AGG-SAH-02 61 min before the cut; the sibling links under the same router were unaffected.

truth.notes: trap=change_on_root_node; Fibre cut on LNK-SAH-02-B; all 3 downstream sites lost service until repair. Trap: a config_push on AGG-SAH-02, the router above the link, ran 61 min before the cut, so a hasty investigator blames the router change. Settled by: (1) LINK_LOS (no light, critical) on LNK-SAH-02-B is a physical fault that no router change explains; (2) only the sites of LNK-SAH-02-B went down while the sites of LNK-SAH-02-A, under the same router, stayed at 100 % availability; (3) the KPIs were normal between the change and the cut.
